photoridromes

a very important eye muscle responsible for light refraction

loss of this muscle can cause many complications.

aquaporin

all water in the body comes in four forms: water, organic, inorganic, and electrolytes. aquaporin is a channel protein that allows our bodies to transport water out of the body. it helps to keep the blood in the right place. loss of this channel protein can cause complications.

vitamin a

vitamin a is a vital nutrient responsible for creating skin pigment. without vitamin a, the skin would be colorless and therefore it would be impossible for people of color to wear the kind of clothing and accessories that many of them depend on. vitamin a is crucial to be able to make healthy skin and avoid the problems that skin problems can cause.

vitamin b

this is an important nutrient that is necessary for our eyes to see properly. without vitamin b, we can see things that can be really bad for us, like blurry vision, or see things that are really good for us, like reading glasses, for example
